messages:
maria: Heads up — product wants new runtime metrics for routing policy evaluations. We need a label stewardship plan before we push this into prod dashboards.

sam: What fields are they asking for?

maria: They listed: policy_id, evaluation_outcome, decision_latency_ms, candidate_model, reason_code, route_bucket. Also asked for customer_tier for cost slices.

oliver: Sounds useful but huge cardinality risk if we include policy_id + candidate_model + customer_id. We should avoid raw ids in labels. Hashing customer_id or using tier only.

jen: +1. My proposal: keep labels to env, region, policy (coarse), outcome, model_family. No raw customer ids in Prom labels. If needed, store customer_id as a hashed attribute elsewhere or in exemplars.

maria: Also need OTel mapping for the collector. Rough mapping idea: routing.decision_latency -> instrumentation.metric.routing.decision_latency_ms; telemetry label mapping: policy -> metric.label.policy, outcome -> metric.label.outcome, model_family -> metric.label.model_family.

sam: Example of the Prom export we should aim for:
```prom
routing_decision_latency_ms_bucket{env="prod",region="us-west-2",policy="pf_v2",outcome="allow",model_family="rw_vicuna_q4"} 42
```
This avoids model_version in the label.

metrics-bot: New doc created: https://docs.redwood/ops/label-stewardship (owner: maria)

oliver: For dashboards, we want pre-aggregated 1m series and rollups. Consider a dedicated metric name pattern like routing_decision_latency_by_policy to make it explicit. Also we need a cardinality guard in Prom/Alerting to notify if the label count for policy/model_family spikes.

jen: Proposed rollout plan: create a debug metric (routing.policy_debug) with limited retention, enable on 5% of traffic for 48h, review label cardinality and dashboard usefulness, then promote to stable metric name and longer retention.

sam: Ops suggestion: enforce unique label values per metric window (5m) <= 500 for any production metric, otherwise drop high-cardinality labels at scrape time or sample.

maria: I'll draft the naming conventions and label guidelines and add them to the stewardship doc. Assigning @jen to own the canary rollout and @sam to implement the OtelCollector relabeling.

jen: :thumbsup: I'll schedule the canary and the dashboard templates.

sam: I'll open a PR with the otel-collector config patch and unit tests for label sets. Will add relabel_configs to drop model_variant in prod.

oliver: Quick note: use Prom relabel_configs to rewrite model_family from model string and drop model_version for non-debug envs. Keeps cardinality down.

maria: Thanks all. Action items — maria: draft doc; sam: PR; jen: canary; oliver: dashboard templates. Aim to close in one week unless blockers. :calendar:
